# site type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/siteType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The purpose of a location when used as an organizational site — headquarters, branch, registered office. Non-functional: a single location may serve multiple purposes for the same or different organizations.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) -> [`gmeow:SiteType`](../classes/gmeow-SiteType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md) from [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) to [`gmeow:SiteType`](../classes/gmeow-SiteType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md), [`gmeow:SiteType`](../classes/gmeow-SiteType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag the purpose(s) a [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) serves as an organizational site — headquarters, branch, or registered office — by referencing [`gmeow:SiteType`](../classes/gmeow-SiteType.md) value individuals.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing the location by site purpose (it is a value — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid forcing one purpose; a single location may serve several purposes for the same or different organizations.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md) triples to a [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) referencing [`gmeow:SiteType`](../classes/gmeow-SiteType.md) individuals, pairing with [`gmeow:hasSite`](gmeow-hasSite.md) on the organization that occupies it.

### Examples

- ex:torontoOffice [`gmeow:siteType`](gmeow-siteType.md) [`gmeow:siteTypeHeadquarters`](../individuals/gmeow-siteTypeHeadquarters.md).
